statutes.ordinance_title: New York 14-Day Written Rent Demand & Warranty of Habitability
statutes.raw_statute_text: Requires a 14-day written rent demand before nonpayment eviction. Imposes non-waivable warranty of habitability entitling tenant to rent abatement for hazardous conditions.

statutes.ordinance_title: NYC Right to Counsel & Housing Maintenance Code Hazard Classes
statutes.raw_statute_text: Guarantees free legal representation in housing court for eligible households. Class C immediately hazardous violations (heat, hot water) must be corrected within 24 hours. Class B within 30 days.

statutes.ordinance_title: Spiegel Law & Rent-Impairing Violation Complete Defense
statutes.raw_statute_text: Provides complete defense against nonpayment eviction where uncorrected official hazardous or rent-impairing residential building violations exist.

assistant:
Here are the applicable statutes for this intake:

1. **NY RPAPL § 711(2) & RPL § 235-b (Warranty of Habitability & 14-Day Rent Demand)**
   - Non-waivable warranty entitles tenant to rent reduction/abatement for heat outage and leaks.
   - **Procedural Check for Attorney:** Confirm whether landlord served a formal 14-day written rent demand prior to filing.
2. **NYC Admin. Code § 27-2115 & § 26-1302 (NYC Right to Counsel & Hazard Classes)**
   - Class C (heat/hot water) requires correction within 24 hours.
   - Class B (water leaks) requires correction within 30 days.
   - Tenant is entitled to free full representation if income ≤200% FPL.
3. **NY Social Services Law § 143-b & MDL § 302-a (Spiegel Defense)**
   - Complete defense to nonpayment if official rent-impairing violations remain uncorrected.
